name: promoseven/zkteco-protocol
description: Framework-agnostic PHP implementation of the ZKTeco standalone device protocol. Talks to biometric terminals directly over the network with no vendor DLL, OCX or SDK runtime.

suggest.ext-sockets: Raises the UDP receive buffer above the 64KB default so a whole attendance table fits. Without it, bulk reads on large tables are markedly more likely to fail with 'Incomplete transfer'.
